title: Quick Inv Sorter
body:
📦 Quick Inv Sorter
Quick Inv Sorter is a lightweight quality-of-life mod that adds fast and intuitive inventory management tools to Minecraft.
Sort items, transfer entire inventories, and drag to quick-move stacks — all without leaving your current screen.

---

✨ Features
* Sort inventory sections with a configurable keybind (default: R)
* Multiple sort modes — Default (alphabetical), Largest First, Rarity, and Item Category
* Per-section sort mode — container and player inventory each remember their own selected sort style
* Scroll while hovering over the sort button to cycle through sort modes, then click to sort using the selected mode
* Shift + drag to quick-move items across slots without clicking each one individually
* Transfer buttons — move your entire inventory to a container or vice versa in one click
* Keybind support with configurable behavior
* Multiplayer-safe

---

⚙️ Compatibility
* Minecraft Java Edition
* Fabric
* Works in survival worlds
* Compatible with most storage containers (chests, barrels, etc.)

---

📦 Installation
Download the mod .jar and place it in your mods folder.
Requires Fabric.

---

📝 Notes
* Buttons only appear when a storage container is open
* Sort and transfer buttons are hidden in the creative and player-only inventory screens
* Shift+drag only moves items when both shift and left mouse button are held
